The Founder's Office at INDmoney is a small, high-intensity team that works directly with the Founder and Chief of Staff to identify, design, and execute the company's most critical strategic focus areas
- across growth, new business lines, operational scale, market expansion & improving talent density. If you have ever wanted to build something from scratch, own a problem end-to-end, and see your decisions translate into outcomes within weeks rather than quarters
- this is that opportunity. Founders Office roles at INDmoney have gone on to lead business units, head new verticals, and start new ventures. This is a stepping stone
- one that compresses years of learning into months.

ROLE:
You will own high-stakes clear problem statements
- new product lines, new markets, operational bottlenecks, scaled processes, competitive strategies, organisation design. Work alongside the Founder and Chief of Staff defining various solutions through to execution
- you are not preparing decks for someone else to act on. Move fast across multiple simultaneous workstreams without losing rigour on any of them. Ability to interface with external stakeholders
- partners, investors, regulators, vendors — and drive outcomes You are a strong fit if: You have a clear entrepreneurial ambition — you want to eventually run something of your own or lead a business unit, and you recognise that this role is how you compress that learning curve You solve problems by going to the data first — you are not comfortable with a hypothesis you cannot test or a claim you cannot quantify You operate well in ambiguity — you do not need a fully defined brief to start; you define the brief yourself You have a bias for action that borders on impatience — you find it uncomfortable when a good idea sits still You can influence people who do not report to you and bring stakeholders along without needing formal authority What we are looking for 2–7 years of experience in fintech, consumer tech, investment products, or management consulting Demonstrated ability to own a problem end-to-end — not just analyse it Strong familiarity with financial services, investments, or capital markets — either professionally or as a serious personal practitioner Sharp quantitative and analytical skills — you are comfortable building models, interrogating data, and defending your numbers Exceptional project management instincts — you can run five things in parallel and know which one needs your attention right now

EDUCATION:
Engineering degree or MBA from a top-tier institution. What matters more than the institution is what you have done since. title: Product Manager - Lending
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the end-to-end lending funnel , optimizing each step of the journey (personal details, eligibility check/rejection, KYC, etc.) to maximize conversion and eliminate drop-off leakages Run structured A/B experiments on UX, messaging, and offer presentation to continuously improve conversion rates Monitor CX escalation trends , identify root causes, and drive product enhancements to reduce ticket volume Own and enhance core lending platform modules — LOS (Loan Origination System), LMS (Loan Management System), Risk Engine, and Credit Bureau reporting/integrations Write clear PRDs for funnel, servicing, platform, and partner-integration features Partner with design, front-end, and back-end engineering teams to execute requirements and ship on time Track and report key product metrics — conversion rate, TAT, escalation rate, system uptime/reliability — to inform prioritization Desired

QUALIFICATIONS:
2–4 years of experience in a product management role, preferably at a startup or financial services organization Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable product decisions Proficiency in SQL for querying, data extraction, and basic analysis to support reporting and decision-making Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas, strategies, and findings across technical and business stakeholders Working knowledge of lending systems (LOS/LMS) is preferable, not mandatory Show more Show less Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Job function Product Management Industries Financial Services Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at INDmoney by 2x See who you know Get notified about new Product Manager jobs in Gurugram, Haryana, India . title: Platform Product Manager
jobDescription: requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Your primary responsibility will be to translate real-world financial and user challenges into scalable, tech-enabled solutions powered by data and insight. Key Responsibilities- Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, pain points, and behaviors, and translate them into actionable product requirements and scalable solutions. Use data analytics to inform product decisions and drive iterative improvements in features and platforms. Collaborate closely with product designers, UX specialists, and engineers to bring product concepts to life. Continuously assess the scope and direction of products and projects, contributing new ideas and building roadmaps for execution. Evaluate technical approaches, contribute to technical design discussions, and support early-stage prototyping to de-risk and accelerate development. Requirements- 3–5 years of experience in the consumer tech space. Strong ability to articulate and define product specifications, including diverse use cases and edge scenarios. Flexible and open to rapid iteration and feedback loops. Sharp attention to detail with a high standard for product quality. Customer-obsessed mindset with a focus on delivering tangible value. Execution-oriented, with the ability to move quickly and scale efficiently. Proficient in third-party analytics tools and experienced in working with large datasets; SQL knowledge is a strong advantage. Curious and enthusiastic about research-driven product development. Comfortable with lean development and reusing best practices from across industries and academia. What INDmoney Offers- Beyond compensation, INDmoney provides: A dynamic, informal, and self-driven work culture. The freedom to experiment with innovative ideas and technologies. A fast-paced environment that encourages exponential learning and professional growth. The opportunity to create meaningful impact at scale in the financial technology space. title: Senior Analyst – Growth
jobDescription: Role Overview The Senior Analyst – Growth will be responsible for analysing and improving the performance of INDmoney’s growth funnel, with a primary focus on: Top-of-funnel growth Customer acquisition cost Channel and campaign efficiency User quality and activation ARPU and revenue growth Marketing measurement and attribution The role requires someone who can combine data analysis, commercial understanding and digital marketing knowledge to identify growth opportunities and turn insights into action. Key Responsibilities Growth Funnel Analysis Analyze the complete top-of-funnel journey across impressions, clicks, installs, registrations, activation and first transaction and work with Engineering and product to improve these funnels. Identify funnel leakages, conversion bottlenecks and high-impact optimisation opportunities. Build cohort-level analysis to evaluate the quality and behaviour of users acquired from different channels, campaigns and customer segments. Track the movement of users from acquisition to activation, engagement, monetisation and retention. CAC and spends Efficiency Monitor and manage customer acquisition costs across paid and organic growth channels. Evaluate CAC by channel, campaign, platform, creative, geography, product and customer cohort. Partner with the digital marketing team to optimize campaign allocation and improve return on marketing spend. Identify opportunities to reduce acquisition costs without compromising customer quality. Build frameworks to calculate CAC payback periods, lifetime value and contribution margins. ARPU and Monetisation Analyze ARPU across different customer segments, products, channels and cohorts. Identify opportunities to improve monetisation through higher activation, repeat usage, cross-selling and increased product adoption. Develop a clear understanding of the relationship between acquisition source, user behaviour, retention and revenue. Work with product, business and marketing teams to design initiatives that improve ARPU and lifetime value. Digital Marketing Analytics Analyze data from digital marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, affiliate platforms and mobile measurement tools. Evaluate campaign performance using metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPI, CPA, CAC, ROAS and conversion rates. Support creative, audience and campaign experiments with structured analysis. Ensure consistency between marketing-platform data, attribution data and internal transaction data. Reporting and Decision Support Build automated dashboards and management reports for growth, CAC, ARPU, funnel conversion and campaign performance. Create daily, weekly and monthly growth scorecards. Highlight material deviations, emerging trends and areas requiring immediate action. Translate complex data into simple, actionable recommendations for business and growth leadership. Build forecasts and scenario models for user growth, marketing spends, CAC and revenue. Preferred Background Experience in fintech, consumer internet, e-commerce, gaming, marketplaces or another high-frequency digital business. Understanding of financial products, investing or digital wealth platforms. Experience working with large customer-level datasets. Key Responsibilities Growth Funnel Analysis Analyze the complete top-of-funnel journey across impressions, clicks, installs, registrations, activation and first transaction and work with Engineering and product to improve these funnels. Identify funnel leakages, conversion bottlenecks and high-impact optimisation opportunities. Build cohort-level analysis to evaluate the quality and behaviour of users acquired from different channels, campaigns and customer segments. Track the movement of users from acquisition to activation, engagement, monetisation and retention. CAC and spends Efficiency Monitor and manage customer acquisition costs across paid and organic growth channels. Evaluate CAC by channel, campaign, platform, creative, geography, product and customer cohort. Partner with the digital marketing team to optimize campaign allocation and improve return on marketing spend. Identify opportunities to reduce acquisition costs without compromising customer quality. Build frameworks to calculate CAC payback periods, lifetime value and contribution margins. ARPU and Monetisation Analyze ARPU across different customer segments, products, channels and cohorts. Identify opportunities to improve monetisation through higher activation, repeat usage, cross-selling and increased product adoption. Develop a clear understanding of the relationship between acquisition source, user behaviour, retention and revenue. Work with product, business and marketing teams to design initiatives that improve ARPU and lifetime value. Digital Marketing Analytics Analyze data from digital marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, affiliate platforms and mobile measurement tools. Evaluate campaign performance using metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPI, CPA, CAC, ROAS and conversion rates. Support creative, audience and campaign experiments with structured analysis. Ensure consistency between marketing-platform data, attribution data and internal transaction data. Reporting and Decision Support Build automated dashboards and management reports for growth, CAC, ARPU, funnel conversion and campaign performance. Create daily, weekly and monthly growth scorecards. Highlight material deviations, emerging trends and areas requiring immediate action. Translate complex data into simple, actionable recommendations for business and growth leadership. Build forecasts and scenario models for user growth, marketing spends, CAC and revenue. Preferred Background Experience in fintech, consumer internet, e-commerce, gaming, marketplaces or another high-frequency digital business. Understanding of financial products, investing or digital wealth platforms. Experience working with large customer-level datasets.
